entities.summary: Hugh Thornton is an American professional football offensive tackle. He played college football at Illinois, and was selected by the Indianapolis Colts in the third round of the 2013 NFL draft. Thornton has also been a member of the Atlanta Falcons, Arizona Hotshots, Washington Redskins and Calgary Stampeders.
